newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Pernas stock suspended - KLSE.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Pernas stock suspended - KLSE.

text.p: The stock of Pernas International Holdings Bhd has been suspended from afternoon trading pending a news announcement, said an official at the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
The stock was last traded at 2.89 ringgit, down three cents, with 175,000 shares traded.
Pernas, a hotel and property concern, was suspended in relation to a land acquisition by its subsidiary, property firm United Malayan Land Bhd, the official said.
U.M. Land said on Thursday it was developing a piece of land into a 1.2 billion ringgit ($484 million) integrated township.

The 848-acre (343.2-hectare) land just outside the capital city was acquired from Pernas Properties Sdn Bhd for 68.2 million ringgit via a share swap. Pernas Properties is a unit of state investment company Perbadanan Nasional.
